{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
# The documentation says revenue is stored as text with thousands separators
# e.g., '1,234.56' → 1234.56
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 2: Filter out refunded orders and internal test orders
# - Keep only 'completed' status
# - Exclude rows where revenue_clean == 999999.99 (internal test orders)
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Step 3: Compute total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders)
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Output the result
total_revenue"}
